name: City Council Special Meeting
agenda_text:
NED E DAVIS  KELLY HONIG  SUSAN McSWEENEY  BRAD HALPERN  RAY PEARL
  Mayor  Mayor Pro Tem  Councilmember  Councilmember  Councilmember

  AGENDA
  Special Meeting of the City Council
  CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE
  City Council Chambers
  31200 Oak Crest Drive
  Westlake Village, CA 91361

  WEDNESDAY, AUGUST 21, 2024 – 3:00 p.m.
  .
 ATTEND OR WATCH THE MEETING
 Members of the public may attend in-person in the Council Chambers or watch the meeting
 through Zoom, City Website (Live Stream) or Cable TV Channel 10. City Council Chamber doors
 open 30 minutes before the meeting start time.

 PUBLIC COMMENT/SPEAKERS
 For Special Meetings, public communications are limited to agenda items. Members of
 the public may express comments to the City Council in person at the meeting or may submit
 written comments before or at the meeting. Submit a Public Speaker card or Written Comment
 card to the City Clerk prior to the public comment portion of that item. Public speakers are limited
 to three minutes unless the presiding officer sets a different limit for meeting management
 purposes. An oral summary of written comments may be given at the discretion of the presiding
 officer.

 Written comments may be emailed to the City Clerk's Office at cityclerk@wlv.org no later than
 12:00 p.m. on the meeting date. Written comments will be provided to City Council prior to the
 meeting and posted at https://www.wlv.org/569/City-Council-Supplemental-Packets

 ZOOM VIEWING ONLY:
 Members of the public watching through Zoom will not have the ability to provide comments on
 agenda items. Zoom is offered strictly as an additional viewing platform. To provide comments,
 see Public Comments/Speakers section.

  https://us02web.zoom.us/j/83092891902
  Webinar ID: 830 9289 1902
  One Tap Mobile:
  +16694449171,,83092891902# OR +16699009128,,83092891902#
  Telephone:
  +1 669 444 9171 OR +1 669 900 9128 OR +1 346 248 7799 OR +1 719 359 4580

 3000483.2
 Unless the City Council holds a teleconference meeting under AB 2449 (2022) guidelines, the
meeting will not be cancelled if technical issues occur.

In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related
modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or
services, please call the City Clerk’s office at (818) 706-1613 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.

Any disclosable public records related to an open session item on a regular meeting agenda and
distributed by the City to the City Council less than 72 hours prior to that meeting are available for
public inspection at City Hall (31200 Oak Crest Drive, Westlake Village) during normal business
hours and are posted on the City’s Website - https://www.wlv.org/569/City-Council-Supplemental-
Packets.

CALL TO ORDER: 3:00 p.m.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE:

ROLL CALL:  Councilmembers Pearl, Halpern, McSweeney, Mayor Pro Tem
  Honig, Mayor Davis

APPROVAL OF AGENDA:

PUBLIC COMMENTS:
Public comments on agenda items only. Members of the public may offer comment in-person or
via email as listed on Page 1 of this agenda. Live comments will be limited to three minutes.
Public Comments may be presented via a written comment, see Page 1 for deadline. Complete
a Speaker Card and submit it to the City Clerk to be called to speak while in the Council Chambers.

NEW BUSINESS:

1.  RESOLUTION ADDRESSING NOVEMBER 5, 2024 GENERAL MUNICIPAL
  ELECTION WITH NO MORE CANDIDATES THAN OFFICES TO BE ELECTED;
  RESOLUTION NO. 2361-24 OR RESOLUTION NO. 2362-24 - Consideration of
  making appointments to two City Council offices for a four-year term and canceling
  the election OR holding the election as scheduled.

  City Council will consider adoption of one of the following resolutions:

  RESOLUTION NO. 2361-24: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY
  OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE, CALIFORNIA, MAKING APPOINTMENTS TO TWO CITY
  COUNCIL OFFICES AND CANCELLING THE NOVEMBER 5, 2024 GENERAL
  MUNICIPAL ELECTION
OR
  RESOLUTION NO. 2362-24: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY
  OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE, CALIFORNIA, PROVIDING FOR THE HOLDING OF A
  GENERAL MUNICIPAL ELECTION ON TUESDAY, NOVEMBER 5, 2024 AS
  SCHEDULED

3000483.2
 ADJOURNMENT:

This agenda was posted on Friday, August 16, 2024 at 9:30 a.m. on the City’s website and in the
Posting Board at City Hall.

  City Clerk
  August 16, 2024

 If any additional disclosable public records are distributed to City Council less than 72 hours prior to the
 meeting, such materials are available in City Hall during normal business hours and are posted on the
 City’s Website - https://www.wlv.org/569/City-Council-Supplemental-Packets

 Watch the City Council Meeting Video LIVE or to rewatch a prior meeting video, click “City Council
 Agendas, Minutes & Video” (http://westlakevillage.granicus.com/viewpublisher.php?view_id=8) City
 Council meetings can be seen live on WVTV Channel 10 or via web streaming on www.wlv.org
